Bill.BriefDescription: Placing limitations on making small loans.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to placing limitations on making small loans;adding a new section to chapter 31.04 RCW; and adding a new section tochapter 31.45 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 31.04 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: No licensee may make a loan to a borrower under this chapter ifthat borrower has an outstanding small loan with that licensee that wasmade under chapter 31.45 RCW.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 31.45 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: No licensee may make a small loan to a borrower under this chapterif that borrower has an outstanding loan with that licensee that wasmade under chapter 31.04 RCW.
